title: Peri-peri Spice Mix
description: A punchy peri-peri style pantry blend of paprika, chilli flakes, cayenne, garlic and onion granules, good as a rub for meats or on chips.
steps: Combine all ingredients; store in a jam jar or airtight container.
notes: Use in Peri-peri Chicken with Sweetcorn Salsa (p.165). Also great as a rub for meats or seasoning for oven chips.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
